title: SREV-116 advapi header out-param schema

official_api_shape.description: Official Advapi/Cred pointer-depth and output-parameter shape

source_change.description: Header typedef and hook prototype alignment for out parameters

runtime_matrix.description: Windows build/runtime proof for hooked Advapi/Cred API paths

contracts: advapi.h owns the hooked Advapi Cred function pointer shapes shared by advapi.c and cred.c
hook typedefs that model Windows APIs preserve pointer-depth for out parameters
GetSecurityInfo receives PSID pointer output slots PACL pointer output slots and a PSECURITY_DESCRIPTOR pointer output slot
CredRead receives a credential output slot not a credential value
CredEnumerate receives a credential-array output slot not an opaque input pointer
hook implementation prototypes in advapi.c match the hooked API pointer typedef
this SREV does not change hook selection access masks window-station fallback behavior credential serialization credential conversion or PStore merge logic
